Moving the first gate from level 30 to level 40 is not a good idea. The experiment shows a statistically significant negative effect on 7-day retention: the treatment group had an 18.2% retention rate compared to 19.02% in the control group, representing a -0.82 percentage point difference (a -4.31% relative change). This result is statistically significant with a p-value of 0.00155 and a confidence interval ranging from -1.33 to -0.31 percentage points. The experiment was adequately powered to detect the pre-registered effect size, so this negative result is reliable.
